flashcards.q: How should retaining walls not be handled in Landscaping?
flashcards.a: Framework: The “Three-Tier Hardscape Hierarchy”—Primary (paths, patios), Secondary (retaining walls, steps), Tertiary (ornamental features, furniture). - Materials: Use permeable pavers (infiltration rate >8 mm/hr) to reduce stormwater impact. - Structural calculations: Retaining walls designed per Rankine’s earth pressure theory; max height without reinforcement ~1.2 m. - Accessibility: Follow ADA guidelines—path widths ≥1.2 m, slopes ≤5% for universal access.
